## About me

Hi, I'm Sanskar Bachani. I'm a junior at Claremont McKenna College. I like working with data. I made this site for my Foundations of Data Science in R class.

This site has my data projects for the class. You can find the [code for this site on GitHub](https://github.com/sbachani28/sbachani28.github.io).

Use the Data Viz menu above to explore my projects. Each page includes the R code and data sources.
